title: Projective completion of a finite rank vector bundle
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal E$ a locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module of constant rank $d\geq0$, with vector bundle $\pi:E=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to S$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. The relative Proj
$$\overline E=\underline{\operatorname{Proj}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal O_S\oplus\mathcal E)$$
[def-nagata-relative-proj, lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] is Noetherian, and its structural morphism $r:\overline E\to S$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $t$ is the degree-one section induced by $1$ in the first summand, there is a canonical open immersion $j:E\xrightarrow{\sim}D_+(t)\hookrightarrow\overline E$ with $rj=\pi$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. On every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ trivializing $\mathcal E$, this is the chart $D_+(t)\subset\mathbf P^d_V=\operatorname{Proj}R[t,x_1,\ldots,x_d]$ given on coordinate rings by $x_i\mapsto x_i/t$ [def-nagata-relative-projective-space]. These identifications commute with restriction and changes of linear frame. The morphism $\pi$ is separated and finite type, and $E$ is Noetherian [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Thus $(j,r)$ is a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. At $d=0$ it is the identity compactification of $S$.
